notes: Two artifacts ship the runtime. Node is NOT one of them: it is Alpine's
own nodejs apk packed inside rootfs.tar.gz at /usr/bin/node.
Do NOT substitute a nodejs.org linux-arm64 tarball. That build is glibc
and this rootfs is musl; there is no libc.so.6, so it will not load and
the failure looks like a missing file rather than a wrong libc.
Build or refresh these with tools/build-alpine-rootfs.py.
